item.title: OpenAI Codex - Wikipedia
item.description: OpenAI released Codex CLI on April 16, 2025, as an open-source coding agent that runs locally in the terminal. It connects OpenAI's language models with local code and command-line tasks, enabling them to write and edit code, execute commands, and interact with files through a lightweight interface. [2]
